added: packages/experiments (@sos-2/experiments): Experiment artifacts as spine envelopes (frozen core kind Experiment) plus content carrying the full §5 Experiment contract — TREATMENT_CONTROL (exactly one CONTROL arm with candidate_ref null + one TREATMENT arm) or ALTERNATIVES (>= 2 arms with distinct candidates) design; typed POPULATION (description + typed allocation unit + >= 1 context fact) and ALLOCATION semantics (typed unit that must EQUAL the population unit, RANDOM or DETERMINISTIC_HASH assignment, arms, positive integer ratios); PRIMARY (>= 1) / SECONDARY (>= 0) / GUARDRAIL (>= 1, MANDATORY, explicit thresholds) metrics; typed stopping criteria (MAX_SAMPLES, MAX_DURATION_SECONDS, EARLY_SUCCESS, SAFETY — >= 1 required) and rollback criteria (>= 1 required, each wired to explicit GUARDRAIL metric ids)

packages/experiments lifecycle: the strict, validated phase machine SHADOW -> CANARY -> CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT — no skips (SHADOW -> CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT REJECTED), no backwards moves, no re-entry; TYPED staged exposure levels: SHADOW exposure is exactly 0 (mirrors never serve a live request), CANARY exposure is strictly inside (0, 100) AND on the declared strictly-increasing canary ladder (no undeclared jumps), CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT is exactly 100 (full population); exposure is monotonic non-decreasing (a decrease is a ROLLBACK, not a phase transition); same-phase exposure changes are content revisions, not phase transitions

packages/experiments candidate-fixture: the CandidateState CONTRACT SHAPE (frozen core kind envelope + content mirroring §5 'bounded subgraph replacement with explicit invariants and predicted effects') consumed by the promotion gate — the W9 parallelization fixture for unmerged W7 candidate generation; candidateStateFromLocalCandidate adapts a MERGED W2 LocalCandidate verbatim (the W2 compatibility bridge); causal_claim marks candidates whose promotion requires intervention-grade evidence; the optional confidence mark uses @sos-2/evidence's Confidence contract and is carried, displayed and NEVER consulted for authorization

packages/experiments results: typed ExperimentResultRecord records (deterministic content-addressed ids under the frozen core kind Evaluation — spec/meta-model.md 'Evaluation: benchmark/scenario/protocol/results') LINKED at creation to the candidate (sos://CandidateState) AND the causal hypothesis (sos://CausalHypothesis) AND the experiment, via reference fields AND the three frozen trace links minted by resultTraceLinks: VERIFIES (result -> candidate), OBSERVES (result -> hypothesis), CAUSED_BY (result -> experiment); experimentTraceLinks mints VERIFIES (experiment -> candidate) and DERIVED_FROM (experiment -> hypothesis); truthful 6-state availability per metric outcome with UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED carrying null values (distinct states never silently numeric); results referencing metrics/arms outside their design are rejected (results never float)

packages/experiments evaluation: fail-closed guardrail evaluation — three DISTINCT statuses SATISFIED (SUCCESS within threshold) / BREACHED (SUCCESS beyond threshold OR the guardrail reported FAILURE — a failing guardrail is a breach, never a pass) / NOT_ESTABLISHED (UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED, PARTIAL or missing outcome — never silently treated as success); overall availability maps honestly onto the 6 frozen truth states (SUCCESS only when EVERY primary metric is satisfied AND EVERY guardrail is SATISFIED; UNKNOWN when a guardrail is not established; PARTIAL for secondary-only regressions); typed stopping trigger records (EARLY_SUCCESS blocked by any non-satisfied guardrail, SAFETY fires on any non-satisfied guardrail, MAX_SAMPLES, MAX_DURATION_SECONDS from the envelope creation timestamp) and typed rollback trigger records (wired to guardrail metric ids, fire on BREACHED or NOT_ESTABLISHED — fail-closed), all with EXACT conditions (every condition listed with its satisfied flag)

packages/experiments simulator: the deterministic fixed-seed in-memory experiment simulator — documented mulberry32 PRNG, fixed arm-major/metric-minor stream order, Box-Muller observation noise from DECLARED effect parameters (exactly one per (arm, metric) pair, validated), per-metric availability overrides to exercise the truth-state discipline; every simulated record carries simulated: true + {version: SIMULATOR_VERSION, seed} provenance — EVALUATION INFRASTRUCTURE, never intervention evidence (docs/implementation/TESTING-AND-EVIDENCE.md layer-6 semantics; isSimulatedRecord performs the structural simulation-mark check the promotion gate consumes); determinism pinned by property tests (identical seed + input -> bit-identical results)

packages/experiments golden fixtures: candidate-state.json, experiment.json, experiment-result.json — bit-exactly reproduced by the public API (pinned by test/fixtures.test.ts; the fixture set is internally cross-referenced experiment -> candidate, result -> experiment + candidate + hypothesis)
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace/serialization authority: both packages import minters, envelopes, trace links, canonical serialization, truth states and the envelope lifecycle from @sos-2/semantic-spine; no second identity system, no duplicated envelope logic, no invented core identifiers (Experiment, CandidateState, AssuranceCase, Decision, Evaluation, AuthorityGrant and CausalHypothesis are frozen core kinds used as-is)

Experiment semantics are REALIZED, never redefined (spec/architecture-lock.md): treatment/control or alternatives, population, allocation, metrics, guardrails, stopping and rollback criteria follow the frozen §5 vocabulary; the lifecycle is exactly SHADOW -> CANARY -> CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT with strict validated transitions; guardrail fail-closure keeps 'unknown, failed, unavailable and unsupported' distinct and never silently successful (§18)

the 6 evidence truth states remain distinct and are imported, never redefined; metric outcomes with UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED availability cannot carry values; overall SUCCESS requires every primary AND every guardrail satisfied — a FAILING or UNKNOWN guardrail is never silently treated as success (pinned by negative tests)

no second semantic registry, no frozen-contract changes: all trace links use the 17 frozen types (VERIFIES, OBSERVES, CAUSED_BY, DERIVED_FROM) through the spine's createTraceLink; ids are deterministic and content-addressed; the spine's golden fixtures (Constitution anchor, envelope, trace-link, evidence) are consumed, never duplicated

spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths (W7: search/optimization/retrieval; W8: assurance/verification/recovery-control) are untouched — all W9 changes are additive under the two owned packages packages/experiments and packages/promotion
boundary_changes: one new workspace package @sos-2/experiments, depending at runtime on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/evidence (Confidence contract), @sos-2/provenance (Producer) and @sos-2/architecture (the W2 LocalCandidate type for the compatibility bridge — a merged W2 dependency)
